ISSUE_KIND: pothole
ISSUE: Pothole filled with water in the roadway
DETAILS: The photo shows a large pothole filled with pooled rainwater surrounded by cracked asphalt on the road surface.
ORGANIZATION: Maryland Department of Transportation State Highway Administration
DEPARTMENT: District 3 (Laurel Shop)
WHY: Baltimore Avenue at this location carries US Route 1. The City of College Park clarifies that Baltimore Avenue/Route 1 is maintained by the Maryland State Highway Administration (SHA) rather than municipal public works, and District 3's Laurel maintenance shop covers state highway maintenance in this part of Prince George's County.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "Streets maintained by the State Highway Administration (SHA) Call 301.776.7619 or click here to report issues to SHA. Baltimore Avenue/Route 1; Campus Drive between Baltimore Avenue (Route 1) and River Road; Greenbelt Road/MD-430; Kenilworth Ave/MD-201; River Road; University Boulevard/MD-193."
